title: Fort Témiscamingue Trade Store
axis: Positive X is the short building axis pointing east-northeast. Positive Z follows the long wall toward the southeast.
source: Parks Canada site inventory and an OpenStreetMap named trading-post interpretation feature
identityStatus: Parks Canada identifies the store at the southwest end of the historic group. The mapped fur trade diorama supplies an estimate of its location and main axis. It is interpreted with the historic two-store group identified by Roy and Drouin and the large shore-side gabled mass in the 1876 Qualla photograph.

features.role: Current interpretive footprint used to estimate historic trade store placement

terrainContact.basis: Original ground on the shore side of the historic store estimate.

notes: The western store is the nearest shore-side store position. The eastern store is independently documented in the excavation and needs its own placement. Dimensions and exact attribution of the distant photographic mass remain approximate.
